plain_process.where: plain python process in the prefect image, box idle, taken before the runs

plain_process_after_runs.where: plain python process in the prefect image, taken after the runs

canonical_source: median of the three uncontended plain-process measurements taken on the idle box; this is the figure used for every ceiling percentage
spread_note: The body is 0.111s uncontended and up to 0.125s when measured inside a single @task thread or a pool subprocess (interpreter warm-up and one-off scheduling noise, each measured once rather than in a loop). Using the slowest figure the ceiling would be 160.1 units/s instead of 180.0, which moves in_process cpu from 4.7% to 5.2% of ceiling and changes no conclusion.
